name: Moon over Pearl (Nguyệt Châu Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while you hold all three, each foe art your ward absorbs also lays one Nacre on the Fist Pearl; when the Fist Pearl spends its Nacre, your ward freezes for 2 s and cannot be broken, and the pearl you cast next carries 2 Ice stacks.

story: The pearl of 470, the mistresses' robe and the grandmother's pin. Kiều Nguyệt Châu holds all three; the Moon-Well Pendant stays in her keeping, unworn. She means the pin for her grand-niece, which would split the set.
